# The column names the exported event log carries for each value type, one line per
# type, names in ascending order. This file is data on purpose: a repo-wide rename over
# *.go cannot reach it, so the guard in archiveschema_test.go still fires.

*model.CompensableValue: ElementId, ElementInstanceKey, HandlerNode, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey, ScopeKey, Seq
*model.DataObjectValue: Bool, Kind, Name, ProducerKey, ScopeKey, State, Text
*model.DecisionEvaluationValue: DecisionId, ElementId, ElementInstanceKey, InputsJSON, OutputsJSON, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey, TraceJSON
*model.ElementInstanceValue: AttachedToKey, BpmnElementType, ElementId, EventGatewayKey, FlowScopeKey, MultiInstance, ParentTokenID, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey, SourceFlowId, TokenID
*model.InboundDeliveryValue: SourceID, SourceSeq
*model.IncidentValue: ElementId, ElementInstanceKey, JobKey, Message, ProcessInstanceKey, RaisedAt, Reason
*model.JobValue: Assignee, CandidateGroups, Deadline, ElementInstanceKey, JobType, LeaseEpoch, LeaseExpiresAt, ProcessInstanceKey, Retries, RetryDueDate
*model.MessageFlowValue: CorrelationKey, MessageName, ReceiverElementId, ReceiverProcessDefKey, ReceiverProcessInstanceKey, SenderProcessInstanceKey
*model.MessageSubscriptionValue: CorrelationKey, ElementId, ElementInstanceKey, MessageName, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey
*model.OperatorActionValue: Actor, ElementInstanceKey, FromProcessDefKey, JobKey, Kind, ProcessInstanceKey, Reason
*model.ProcessInstanceValue: CompletedAt, CompletedPosition, CorrelationKey, CreatedAt, ExpiryDueDate, ParentElementInstanceKey, PredecessorInstanceKey, ProcessDefKey, PurgeDueDate, State, SuccessorInstanceKey
*model.ProcessMigrationValue: FromProcessDefKey, Mapping, ProcessInstanceKey, ToProcessDefKey
*model.SignalSubscriptionValue: ElementId, ElementInstanceKey, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey, SignalName
*model.TimerValue: DueDate, ElementInstanceKey, JobKey, JobKind, ProcessDefKey, ProcessInstanceKey, Repetitions, TargetElementId
*model.VariableAuditValue: Actor, Bool, Kind, Name, ProcessInstanceKey, ScopeKey, Text
*model.VariableIndexValue: Indexed, Name, ProcessInstanceKey
*model.VariableValue: Bool, Index, Indexed, Kind, Name, ProducerKey, ScopeKey, Text
